info.title: agent-computer control API
info.description: Development control API: revocable service credentials, independent runtime grants, authorized definition plans, queued Computer start admission, durable connection and writer coordination, authenticated bounded file reads/saves, trusted guarded execution workers with durable outputs, and sealed Workspace artifacts with file-only checkpoint restart. Trusted operators provision storage and publish artifacts. Computer Ready, browser/OIDC, arbitrary-process storage fencing, App/profile checkpoint capture, Presentation, GC and full product acceptance remain pending.

post.description: Requires Computer activate, Workspace read/modify, App app.use/activate, private profile app.use and corresponding credential scopes. Pins the immutable dependency graph, allocates a generation and Candidate ID and reserves capacity atomically. Returns Queued only. A committed Workspace input is pinned; missing input returns 409. Storage preparation runs through a separate trusted worker; this HTTP call dispatches no storage/Pod operation. Replays require current authorization and do not transfer the original credential binding. Multiple Computers may own independent Candidates in the same Workspace; each reserves its own capacity. input_artifact_id selects a published same-Workspace Artifact; unavailable or unauthorized selection returns the same 404.

post.description: Requires runtime.manage and an exact Computer manage grant. Stops an undispatched Prepared Candidate or a Sealed file-only Computer with a verified published Artifact, including a retained branch or CAS conflict. Undrained writers, dispatched process executions, queued work, required uncaptured Apps or active human input block checkpoint stop. Retains old Candidate storage. A normal next start pins the current Workspace head; input_artifact_id explicitly selects the checkpoint version. Either allocates a new Candidate without changing the head. Queued cancellation remains separate.

get.description: Requires configured output gateway, original valid submission credential with runtime.connect and runtime.read scopes, and current Computer connect/read plus original Workspace read grants. No active connection, current Candidate, writer lease or modify grant is needed for historical output. Current authority is checked before and after the bounded S3 GET, including error responses. Publication must be verified; each read rechecks the immutable object size and SHA-256. Maximum retained stream size is the admitted command limit (at most 1 MiB). No object key, URL, supervisor report or diagnostics are exposed. No ranges, offsets or live tailing.

post.description: Requires current Computer read/modify/manage and Workspace read/modify/publish grants with matching credential scopes. By default atomically seals an already drained Candidate. With cancel_running=true, first durably enters Draining, rejects new modifications and requests cancellation; captures only after every execution and IO drain is proved. Unknown remains blocked. A trusted artifact-worker captures and verifies S3 content, then publishes the fixed version and records the Computer stop in one transaction. Declared Apps, active human input, another principal's live connection, unresolved execution history block completion; force is unsupported. publish_current chooses head CAS or a retained branch checkpoint. A CAS conflict still saves the fixed checkpoint and stops without overwriting the shared head. Repeating the same key/input returns current work and may refresh the original principal's credential; it does not reopen mutation. A 202 response does not mean stopped: inspect stop_receipt in Artifact metadata or Computer runtime.

PlannedResource.description: Resolved before/after resource spec, stable ID and immutable dependency versions. Name and expectedRevision are metadata outside the spec. requires_drain is a reconciliation requirement; no runtime transition has occurred.

DefinitionPlan.description: Immutable caller-owned plan; at most 8 MiB serialized, valid for first apply for 15 minutes by database clock. Missing declarations never delete existing data. Returned principal/organization come from authentication, not client input.

DefinitionOperation.description: Current operation metadata and per-intent progress from one organization-locked snapshot. event_sequence is the publication event; watermark is the observation stream position. Apply creates Queued/Pending metadata. Trusted coordination APIs can advance it, but this release has no runtime backend worker; database fixtures do not certify runtime success.

IntentProgress.description: Durable coordination status. attempts is the monotonically increasing coordinator lease epoch, not runtime generation. dispatch_started means an external effect may have occurred; it is not proof of execution or process termination.

RuntimeAccess.description: Current caller grants intersected with this credential scopes. This is informational, not a reusable permit, lease, budget reservation or runtime readiness statement. No inheritance across permissions, resources or related objects.

expected_revision.description: Control revision, initially 1; distinct from definition revision and generation.

expected_spec_revision.description: Current Computer definition revision to pin.

input_artifact_id.description: Optional published Artifact from this Computer's Workspace, including a retained branch or CAS conflict. Omitted/null pins the current Workspace head. Selection creates a new Candidate and never moves the head; current Workspace read/modify grants are required.

StartReceipt.description: Immutable original admission receipt. A replay can still say Queued after cancellation; read current runtime state. It is not permission to dispatch an external effect.

input_revision.description: Pinned committed Workspace input version; absent only in legacy receipts.

input_manifest_digest.description: Pinned input manifest digest; absent only in legacy receipts.

input_artifact_id.description: Fixed Artifact provenance, including a default head produced by an Artifact. Absent for genesis input and legacy receipts.

ComputerRuntime.description: Current admission control state. This development implementation cannot report runtime Ready.

ConnectRequest.description: Logical connection only. Identity derives from the current service credential; it is permanently bound to that credential. Capabilities are requested Computer permissions, not resource grants or available backend features. Lifetime is capped by credential expiry.

ConnectionHeartbeat.description: Self-reported presence only; not verified user input, readiness, billing or an idle-stop signal. Does not extend the session or identity lifetime.

ConnectionSession.description: Current own-session view. Replays return this current view, not a cached authority snapshot. Non-Active sessions expose no capabilities. Closing or revoking never certifies that a writer or process stopped.

AcquireWriterLease.description: Current Prepared Candidate only. Session must belong to the exact credential and request connect/read/modify; current Computer connect/read/modify and Workspace read/modify grants are all required. Duration is capped by the session deadline.

WriterLeaseCommand.description: Exact current owner, Computer generation, ownership epoch and lease revision CAS.

RenewWriterLease.description: Renew a live Held lease. Never shortens the existing deadline or exceeds the session deadline. Exact retries do not extend it twice.

WriterLease.description: Current own-epoch control metadata, not an IO capability. Held becomes effectively Draining on expiry or authority loss. Released requires zero-dispatch proof or a sealed bounded file adapter completion with confirmed drain. Uncertain IO without such proof remains Draining. Ready remains false.

FileEditReport.description: Result of the bounded trusted file adapter. Unknown may have a version and confirmed drain when physical IO completed but authorization was lost before database acceptance. Unknown IO without confirmed drain blocks handoff. This is not a general process fencing receipt.

path.description: Normalized relative UTF-8 path, at most 1024 bytes, 32 components, 255 bytes/component. No dot, empty, symlink, backslash, NUL, mount crossing or reserved staging components.

expected.description: Null or omitted requires absence; otherwise exact previous content/mode version.

argv.description: Absolute executable in argv[0], no NUL, total argv at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; explicit interpreter required for scripts.

cwd.description: Empty or normalized relative directory: no slash prefix, backslash, NUL, dot/dot-dot or empty segments; at most 32 segments of 255 UTF-8 bytes.

ExecutionCommand.description: Shared supervisor bounds. Timeout also cannot exceed the pinned Computer start budget. No env/stdin references yet.

renewable.description: New admissions allow trusted worker renewals by default. False pins fixed startup protocol v1. Retry identity distinguishes omitted, true and false. Historical rows retain their original fixed policy.

SubmitExecution.description: Bounded queue reservation on a Prepared Candidate. Background (default) survives logical connection close; connection lifetime requires an active connection. The queue deadline cannot be renewed. New renewable admissions allow the original worker to extend execution windows by at most 30 seconds after fresh authorization and both node watchdog acknowledgments. The immutable execution hard limit is capped by command timeout plus 30 seconds, the pinned Computer start duration and original credential expiry; connection lifetime also caps it by session expiry. This is an execution duration, not a full Computer activation or idle lifetime implementation. Original grants, catalog and generation remain required. Selected gVisor Sandbox must belong to the pinned Computer snapshot and cannot host an App. Public runtime execution remains unsupported.

CancelExecution.description: CAS cancellation: Queued becomes Cancelled; Dispatching becomes CancelRequested and its writer starts draining. Unknown remains unresolved. No process termination or lease release is asserted.

dispatch_started.description: True after the durable dispatch intent commits; does not assert that a process started or stopped.

lifetime.description: Immutable submitted lifetime, included in the input digest.

renewable.description: Immutable admitted policy. False for historical fixed execution records. This does not indicate a live controller or a renewed deadline.

ExecutionRequest.description: Current execution metadata bound to the original credential. Succeeded/Failed require a live kernel and Candidate IO seal, verified output and current authority; dispatched Cancelled requires the seal and an explicit cancellation request. Unknown preserves uncertainty even when physical writes are sealed. Queue deadline is fixed at admission and never extended by retry or lease renewal.

ComputerStopReceipt.description: Historical stop receipt with retained Candidate storage. artifact_checkpoint identifies a verified published file-only checkpoint; no_user_dispatch retains the original pinned input. Neither proves fencing of arbitrary processes.

CommitArtifact.description: Permanently seals a Prepared Candidate whose bounded file writers are all drained. The expected revision is the current Computer control revision; the base identifies its pinned Workspace input. No caller manifest or drain proof is accepted.

ArtifactCommit.description: Immutable publication identity and current status. Conflict preserves a fixed input version but leaves the default Workspace pointer unchanged. Capturing is sealed and may require the same-key retry with renewed publisher credentials plus a trusted operator retry. Opt-in checkpoint cancellation stays Draining until all writers have durable drain evidence; it cannot publish from Draining.

stop_after_commit.description: True only for an admitted checkpoint-stop; publication and stopping finish in one transaction.

drain_reason.description: Present while Draining; recovery_blocked means an execution remains Unknown.

ArtifactManifest.description: Relative file tree of a fixed artifact. Published only after full object verification; storage credentials, object paths and signed URLs are never returned.

oneOf.description: An empty or nonempty relative directory.
A regular file. Executable permission is retained; ownership, timestamps, special bits and links are not portable metadata.

WorkspaceCheckpoint.description: File-only Computer checkpoint: no declared Apps, and every dispatched execution must have accepted completion plus process and IO drain evidence. Unknown blocks capture. App/profile capture and general process fencing are pending.

cancel_running.description: Explicitly request cancellation of queued/running Candidate executions. Durably enters Draining and rejects new writes before waiting for existing process and IO drain evidence. Unknown blocks capture; no Apps or other active use allowed.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one header. Scoped to authenticated organization, principal and operation. Reusing a key with changed input returns 409; retired receipts return 410. Retry unknown outcomes with the same key and input.
